title: Scenario province data
description: scenario/provinces_data.json (named by the scenario's provinceDataFile): per-province changes applied when a new game starts. population is written to the province and the owning country's total follows; terrain and resources are static and are re-applied on every load. Starting buildings are not covered.

population.description: People in the province at the start.

terrain.description: Terrain type (movement, combat, building sites). The map's terrain colours do not change.

resources_mode.description: replace (default): the listed resources replace the province's deposits; add: they are added to them.

resource.description: Resource name, for example Oil, Iron, Wheat.
